item.title: Hegseth once warned against endless wars. Now he’s leading Trump’s strike-first doctrine
item.summary: Trump administration launches unprecedented military campaign spanning Venezuela to Iran in assertive foreign policy shift under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Texas Gov Abbott issues warning of Chinese spying in medical tech
item.summary: Texas Gov. Abbott warns of Chinese spying through medical devices, directing health agencies to address cybersecurity risks after federal alerts.

item.title: Iran’s new supreme leader is ‘his father on steroids,’ experts warn of hardline rule
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei reportedly selected as Iran's new supreme leader in succession move, described as 'his father on steroids' with deeper security ties.

item.title: Coast Guard cutter Munro returns to California home after record-breaking 11-Ton cocaine seizure
item.summary: Following a mission in the Atlantic and Pacific, the USCGC Munro crew returns home with record-breaking results in the fight against transnational criminal networks.

item.title: Suspect in NYC terror probe planned attack 'bigger than the Boston Marathon bombing,' prosecutors say
item.summary: Federal prosecutors said on Monday that a suspect in the NYC protest attack planned an assault “bigger than the Boston Marathon bombing."

item.title: Wife of teacher killed in senior prank makes unexpected request for charged students
item.summary: A Georgia teacher's wife has asked that charges be dropped against the high school students involved in the fatal toilet paper prank accident that killed her husband.

item.title: Schumer once blocked Trump's move to fill the nation's oil reserves, now he wants them opened
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., wants President Donald Trump to tap into the nation's oil reserves, which were heavily drawn down under former President Joe Biden.

item.title: James Carville goes on profanity-laced tirade against Trump, admits he has 'derangement syndrome'
item.summary: Democratic strategist James Carville admitted that he has "Trump Derangement Syndrome" in a profanity-filled rant on Saturday, saying he wants to hate the president even more.

item.title: Obama appointee’s Chicago immigration order backfires after court says she went too far
item.summary: An appellate court panel found 2-1 that Judge Sarah Ellis' order attempted to establish "the district court as the supervisor of all Executive Branch activity in the city of Chicago."

item.title: Colts shell out historic free agent deal to keep receiver Alec Pierce
item.summary: The Colts signed receiver Alec Pierce to a record $116 million deal, while also trading Michael Pittman Jr. to the Steelers, who eye a Aaron Rodgers reunion.
